description: This file is a shell script used for testing the cache-tree feature in a git repository. It contains test functions and sequences to verify cache-tree updates through various git commands such as add, commit, reset, checkout, and merge.

methods.name: cmp_cache_tree
methods.description: Compare the current cache-tree dump with an expected output file after filtering out references.

methods.name: generate_expected_cache_tree
methods.description: Recursively generate the expected cache-tree output for a given pathspec, including subtrees.

methods.name: test_cache_tree
methods.description: Generate and compare the current cache-tree against an expected output to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_invalid_cache_tree
methods.description: Verify cache-tree output when invalid data is present.

methods.name: test_no_cache_tree
methods.description: Verify that the cache-tree is empty.
